description: This file declares the Client class within the rialto::servermanager::ipc namespace, which manages IPC communication with a server manager component. It includes method declarations for connecting, setting state and configuration, pinging, setting log levels, and handling disconnection events, along with private methods for handling specific events. The class interacts with external components such as ISessionServerAppManager, IChannel, IpcLoop, and ServerManagerModule_Stub.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Manages IPC client operations for server management, including connection, configuration, and event handling.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the Client with session manager, server ID, and socket.

methods.description: Sends a ping message to the server.
